hypothesis: Observed detection and positive expression have different assay shifts; a dual-view WT-only atlas can preserve coarse state identity more reliably than log-expression-only PCA
atlas_fit: All approved E8.5 WT cells only; PCA12 on log-expression and PCA12 on binary observed-detection; scale each view by sqrt(mean PC variance), concatenate, kmeans8
conditional_activation: Original WT-only log-expression association with own-gene linear contribution excluded; detection PCA never enters the propensity regression
response: v88 additive detection fractions and positive quantile shift with original nKO/(nKO+50) shrinkage
emitter: Original conditional v88; positive counts and geometry unchanged except required response and row closure
intervention_exclusion: Each evaluation query KO excluded from every aggregate response fit; WT atlas uses no KO cells
comparison: Same fixed seven genotype, embryo-balanced controls, three seeds, four arms as initial route
